title: The Cliff Lift
synopsis: The field lamps go out behind the train, and the Hush comes over the moor. The line ends at a tall chalk cliff. There is only one way up: the old cliff lift.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Next stop: Cliff Town. Hold the bar!
The lamps went out. It's here.
The line ends! The old cliff lift!
It can't fly. Up we go!
It's walking around the cliff. Go!
Cliff Town! Thank you, old lift.
It will be back. Hold the bar.
